items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee Danny Barker does not speak in the provided context; the name 'Christopher' is mentioned by the interviewer as the grandson of Barker's wife's son.

ctx.x: Well, she had two husbands. Her first husband was Rene Browner(?), and he passed away. She had one son for him, Larry Browner. And Larry has a little boy, Christopher, and now got one on the way.
Is that so?! I didn't know that. That's great.
